mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, login_id AS loginId, name, email, birth_date AS birthDate, gender, height_cm AS heightCm, weight_kg AS weightKg, bmi, trait_companion AS traitCompanion, trait_competition AS traitCompetition, trait_place AS traitPlace, trait_intensity AS traitIntensity FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workout_logs ( user_id, sport_id, exercise_date, duration_min, intensity, calories_kcal, memo, source, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, (SELECT sport_id FROM sports WHERE name = #{sportName} LIMIT 1), STR_TO_DATE(#{workoutDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), #{durationMin}, CASE WHEN #{intensity} = '가볍게' THEN 'LIGHT' WHEN #{intensity} = '숨차게' THEN 'HARD' ELSE 'MODERATE' END, #{caloriesBurned}, #{memo}, 'MANUAL', NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT w.log_id AS logId, w.user_id AS userId, w.sport_id AS sportId, s.name AS sportName, w.duration_min AS durationMin, w.intensity AS intensity, w.calories_kcal AS caloriesBurned, w.exercise_date AS workoutDate, w.memo AS memo, w.source AS source FROM workout_logs w LEFT JOIN sports s ON w.sport_id = s.sport_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.exercise_date = CURDATE() ORDER BY w.created_at DESC

SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(*), 0) AS weekCount, IFNULL(SUM(duration_min), 0) AS weekDuration FROM workout_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND exercise_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 6 DAY)

SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM workout_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND exercise_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(calories_kcal), 0) FROM workout_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND exercise_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 6 DAY)
SELECT s.name AS sportName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM workout_logs w JOIN sports s ON w.sport_id = s.sport_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY w.sport_id, s.name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT s.name AS sportName, w.duration_min AS maxDuration FROM workout_logs w JOIN sports s ON w.sport_id = s.sport_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.duration_min DESC, w.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
